copy.title: The Docket
copy.tagline: Protect a child's childhood before the system devours it.
howTo: Use the arrow keys (or swipe) to move through the docket.
Collect every bit of childhood before the system's mechanisms reach you.
Grab a Reform (the big markers) to turn the tables — then push the system back.
Four mechanisms chase you in different ways. Clear the maze to win. (Phase 2.)
endLines: You can clear every maze and the system still grinds on.
Protecting one child at a time can't fix a rigged docket.
Reform is the only real win.
copy.shareText: I tried to protect a child's childhood from the docket in The Docket. The system is the real boss. Beat my score.
